## Products

### BTP xID — Service Key Governance & Access Management for SAP BTP

BTP xID (https://www.terrabt.com/products/btp-xid) is a governance tool for SAP BTP service keys, API credentials, and user access. It is available as a web app (https://xid-web.terrabt.com) and a desktop app for macOS and Windows.

Facts about SAP BTP service keys that BTP xID addresses:

- SAP BTP service keys have no owner field. The platform does not record who owns a key or who is accountable for it.
- SAP BTP service keys do not expire. They remain valid until explicitly deleted.
- SAP BTP has no field describing what a service key is for, and no record of which system or integration consumes it.
- SAP BTP has no rotation workflow and no last-rotated timestamp for service keys.
- SAP BTP has no single view of users and keys across global accounts, subaccounts, and Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces. Access reviews require visiting each one individually.
- Removing a user from a subaccount does not delete or rotate the service keys they created, and BTP does not record who created a key. When a person with access to a key's secret leaves, security standards require rotating the key and reassigning its ownership.

What BTP xID adds: owner, responsible party, purpose, and expiry fields on every credential (stored as metadata on the credential itself, in the customer's own landscape); one-click rotation with a rotation record; a single cross-account view of all users and API credentials including reverse search by user; and a Security Insights governance score showing which credentials are missing owners, expiry dates, or purpose.

These gaps affect specific compliance controls: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (A.5.15, A.8.20, A.8.24), NIST SP 800-53 (IA-4, IA-5, AC-2), PCI DSS 4.0 (8.3.10.1, 8.6), SOC 2 Type II (CC6.1, CC6.2, CC7.1), and SOX IT General Controls. A control-by-control mapping is published at https://www.terrabt.com/products/btp-xid/compliance

## Our Services

### SAP BTP Architecture & Design
Strategic architecture planning for scalable, secure SAP BTP environments. Services include landscape design, security architecture, high availability configuration, and cloud infrastructure setup.

### SAP Fiori Application Development
Custom Fiori application development using SAPUI5 framework. We build responsive, user-friendly applications with modern UI/UX design following SAP Fiori guidelines.

### SAP CAP Development
Full-stack development using SAP Cloud Application Programming Model. We create robust backend services, OData APIs, and enterprise-grade applications.

### SAP Build Apps (Low-Code Development)
Rapid application development using SAP Build Apps platform. Ideal for citizen developers and quick prototyping of business applications.

### SAP Build Process Automation
Workflow automation, RPA (Robotic Process Automation), and document processing solutions to streamline business operations.

### AI-Powered Invoice Processing
Intelligent invoice processing automation with advanced AI for accurate data extraction and seamless SAP integration.

### SAP BTP Integration Suite
Enterprise integration services including Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, Open Connectors, and Integration Advisor implementation.

### SAP Event Mesh
Event-driven architecture implementation for real-time, responsive business processes using SAP Event Mesh.

### Offline PWA Applications
Progressive Web Applications with offline capabilities for seamless user experience on any device, anywhere.

### SAP BTP Database Management
Database design, optimization, and management for SAP HANA Cloud, PostgreSQL, and SAP ASE databases.

### Design Thinking Workshops
User-centered design approach to identify innovative SAP BTP solutions that solve real business challenges.
